submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires most on a token that is the locally predictable completion of the immediately preceding 1-2 tokens (an idiomatic bigram or collocation such as fell silent, chemical energy, on the, or heavy rain); the identical token in an unpredictable local bigram context activates less.
